title: We could win popular election but lose the electoral college (again). We need a candidate that can shave off only a few points from Trump in Michigan
summary: We could win popular election but lose the electoral college (again). We need a candidate that can shave off only a few points from Trump in Michigan and Pennsylvania....like really small numbers..IMO Klobuchar speaks best to Christmas Sweater Crowd
